title: Zero Filling and Persistent Free Subgroups of the Figure-Eight Knot

initial.initial: The exact union quantifier means every filling quotient separately. Triviality of H double-derived in the zero-filling group suffices, independent of embedding. Nonmeridional infinitude needs hyperbolic exterior and exact rational exceptional list, toroidal injection, infinite triangle quotients, and sign symmetry. A candidate strengthening to arbitrary fibered knots needs a separate hypothesis, and is outside the paper.

proof: All rational slopes include the longitude slope 0; infinity denotes the meridian and is absent. Intersecting with the union is requiring each filled-quotient map to be injective, distinct from the product map. The universal assertion fails on any qualifying knot.

The zero-filled manifold fibers over a circle with torus fiber, giving short exact 1→Z²→G→Z→1. The quotient is abelian, so the derived group is in Z² and its own derived subgroup vanishes. This kills the nontrivial reduced length-16 commutator of commutators in every embedded rank-two free group, independently of embedding.

All nonexceptional rational fillings are closed hyperbolic, with infinite fundamental group since a finite-sheeted cover of the compact base cannot be hyperbolic 3-space. The three toroidal exceptional slopes contain an incompressible torus. The remaining positive slopes have the indicated hyperbolic triangle quotient, and amphichirality accounts for the negatives. No need for the misprinted equality at the middle slope.
